name: 101 Workspace
scope: 101 operating dashboards; not merchant public-site branding

decisions.decision: Fast, precise, useful. One restrained shell; avoid decorative administrative heroes and mandatory assistants.
Larger readable text, darker secondary copy, shorter headers; visually inspect every render against saved references and refine.
Update this same identity and tokens with future requested design changes; reuse across 101 dashboards instead of copied themes.
Plain task labels, compact results, direct attention links and factual activity. Demo web analytics is explicitly fictional and separate from received business data.

Shared live identity sheet; compact factual Inicio, email working review and isolated analytics fixture. Visible chart scale, bounded activity and readable exclusions. Preserve creation-date context across navigation and clear selected objects on business changes.

decisions.source: authorized Stage6 implementation and rendered review
decisions.decision: Adopt shared identity for Clientes → Fidelización; extract exact-money/form controls, preserve financial table columns, and distinguish configuration, assumptions, historical cost and unresolved evidence. This records implementation behavior, not a new brand approval.

decisions.source: user explicit rejection of gray-on-gray and gray backgrounds
decisions.decision: Reject gray canvas and low-contrast gray-on-gray compositions. Compare white/ink, white/cobalt, white/violet, cream/forest and black/lime using identical content. Replacement choice pending; runtime tokens remain legacy until an actual selection and consumer review.

decisions.source: user clarification and request for actual app
decisions.decision: Gray with white can work; reject gray-on-gray, not gray categorically. Supersedes the prior no-gray-canvas interpretation. Compare candidates inside actual demo workflows using local selector; no permanent theme chosen.

decisions.source: user requests several actual-app options together
decisions.decision: Show side-by-side actual app captures with direct links, explicitly comparing gray panels on white and white panels on gray alongside other colors. Do not present a single linked choice as the comparison.

decisions.source: authorized Stage7 implementation and actual phone review
decisions.decision: Add original-assignment contribution-profit results with explicit nonbuyers, missing/stale financial evidence, planned customer-level uncertainty and separate cost capture. Keep the main effect and confidence interval together on phones. Reuse existing identity roles and preserve the pending color-preview choice.

Social content reuses the workspace shell and identity. A photo-first production form keeps confirmed text beside the actual rendered image; approval refers to a saved version. Unknown metrics stay unavailable. This first slice is a provisional production workflow, not a new visual identity.

decisions.source: authorized social connection and production continuation
decisions.decision: Expose Instagram in the existing content workflow and link it from Connections. Show setup and missing metrics honestly; use an explicit retry control for interrupted uploads and reuse existing white surfaces/buttons.
